project_type: Kotlin Android app with ViewBinding, XML layouts, Retrofit, Coroutines
test_framework: JUnit 4 with Robolectric and MockWebServer, tests in android/app/src/test/
verification_instructions: Run assembleDebug to verify build, run testDebugUnitTest to verify tests. All changes in android/ folder only.
setup_instructions: JAVA_HOME must be set to /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2. Android SDK dir at /root/android-sdk. local.properties already points to it.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot download new packages. All dependencies already configured. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: All changes must be within the android/ folder. Do NOT modify existing CKCC, OTS, or other report layouts. This is an ADD-ON only.
key_patterns: ViewBinding used for all Activities. Form sections use MaterialCardView with accent strip. Partial layouts included via <include>. VisitFormData is a single class (no longer data class due to JVM 255 limit) holding all form fields with toFieldMap() serialization and validate() method. VisitReportActivity has setUp* methods per section. Constants in companion object.
directory_structure: android/app/src/main/java/com/lrms/recovery/ has: data/ (ApiClient, ApiService, Dto), domain/ (VisitFormData), ui/ (visit/, customer/, main/, login/, etc), util/ (Formatters, FileStore, AppLanguage), location/, reminder/. Layouts in res/layout/, strings in res/values/strings.xml.
